title: Braised Snapper in Croatian-Style Brine
description: A flavorful, slow-cooked snapper dish with a twist from Croatian cuisine, suitable for vegetarians. This recipe is a fusion of traditional flavors with a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: 2. Season the snapper fillet with Croatian seasoning.
3. In a braising pot, combine fish stock, glassy, jelly, and brine. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
4. Add the snapper fillet to the braising liquid and cover the pot.
5. Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 20 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
6. Serve the snapper hot, garnished with additional Croatian seasoning if desired.
7. Serve in individual portions (one per serving)
8. Garnish with a sprig of fresh herbs, if desired.
10. Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.
